items.stem: Under R.A. 6713, may a public employee solicit or accept a gift from anyone in connection with an official transaction?

options.text: Yes, if the gift is worth less than ₱1,000
Yes, if the head of office knows
Yes, after the transaction is finished

reveal.terms: This item is about R.A. 6713, R.A. 6713, Sec. 7(d).

reveal.why_correct: "No" is right. R.A. 6713, Sec. 7(d) says: "Public officials and employees shall not solicit or accept, directly or indirectly, any gift".
